look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Climbing tendrilled vine, divided leaflets and inflated papery three-lobed capsules. Open a mature fruit to see three dark rounded seeds, each with a pale heart-shaped scar.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Slender tendrilled climbing vine; numerous hanging papery fruits.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Alternate compound leaves with lobed or divided leaflets.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small pale flowers; detailed macro still needed.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Inflated papery three-part capsule; round dark seeds with pale heart-shaped hilar mark.

key_traits.label: Stem bud
key_traits.text: Thin climbing stems with tendrils; exact node photo needed.
